info.description: REST + SSE API for the OpenSpec Studio backend.
info.title: OpenSpec Studio API

400.description: invalid kind, or CLI executable not found

post.summary: Run a connectivity health check against a provider

get.description: Lists every change across every registered, available project (or a single project via ?projectId=), including archived changes, with Kanban lifecycle status computed.

parameters.description: Filter to a single registered project
parameters.name: projectId

get.description: Returns a change's full artifact content (proposal/design/tasks/specs) for the Kanban card detail view.

Server-Sent Events stream. Emits an "update" event (with the changed file path as data) whenever a watched project's openspec/ directory changes on disk, plus a periodic heartbeat comment. Not a JSON request/response endpoint - no response schema applies.

Lists a directory's real subdirectories on the machine the backend runs on, flagging each as an existing OpenSpec project and/or empty - powers the in-app Open/New directory picker. Read-only: never creates, modifies, or deletes anything. Defaults to the user's home directory when path is omitted.

parameters.description: Absolute directory path to list (defaults to home directory)
parameters.name: path

400.description: path does not exist or is not a directory

get.description: Reports that the backend process is up, and its version.

Aggregates spec/change progress across every registered project (or a single project via ?projectId=): per-project spec/change-stage counts, a progress ratio, and a broken-cross-project-dependency count, plus aggregate totals and a most-recently-updated list of {projectId, projectName, lastOpenedAt} entries.

parameters.description: Scope the overview to a single registered project
parameters.name: projectId

get.description: Lists every registered project, most recently opened first. A project whose path no longer exists on disk is included with available=false rather than omitted.

post.description: Registers a directory as an active project. Read-only discovery: the directory must already contain a valid openspec/ structure - Open never scaffolds one. Use POST /projects/new for that.

400.description: path missing, does not exist, or has no valid openspec/ structure

post.description: Scaffolds a fresh OpenSpec structure in an empty (or nonexistent-content) directory and registers it, distinct from opening an existing project.

parameters.description: Directory to create the project in
parameters.name: body

400.description: path missing, does not exist, or is not empty

get.description: Lists scheduled flows, optionally filtered to one project.

parameters.description: Filter to a single registered project
parameters.name: projectId

post.description: Only fully-planned changes can be scheduled, and dependency order is validated before the flow is saved.
Terminates the in-progress provider process and marks the flow cancelled; already-succeeded items are left intact.

get.description: Lists every spec across every registered, available project (or a single project via ?projectId=), with resolved dependency links.

parameters.description: Filter to a single registered project
parameters.name: projectId

post.description: Drafts a spec from a short description without writing anything to disk. Uses the default AI provider, or an explicit providerId override, falling back to a deterministic template if none is configured or the provider call fails.

delete.description: Deletes a spec. If other specs depend on it and force=true is not set, returns 409 with the list of dependent specs instead of deleting.

brokenSpecCount.description: specs with an unavailable cross-project dependency
